subject: Error: semTools/runMI/imputed data... using ordered variables ...subscript out of bounds

messages.author: 3f643476a391689e
messages.subject: Error: semTools/runMI/imputed data... using ordered variables ...subscript out of bounds
parts:
Hello,
 
I am trying to use runMI with already imputed data from Amelia. I have 5 imputed data which I have saved in csv file so that I can collapse some of the multi-responses in my data to binary. runMI seems to work if I don't declare some of my variables as ordered but when I do, it gives me the following error:
 
Error in `[<-`(`*tmp*`, lhs, rhs, value = 0.0206262325540084) : 
  subscript out of bounds
 
Here are the steps I followed
 
1. I first read the csv files (5 imputed files from Amelia)
 
im1<- read.csv(...)
..
im5<-read.csv(...)
 
2. I then created a list
 
im_all<-list(im1,im2,im3,im4,im5) 
 
3. I run the model
 
mm<-'...'
 
4. I used sem.mi/runMI
 
fit.mm<-sem.mi(mm, data=im_all, chi="lmrr", ordered=c("var1","var2"))
 
 
If I take out  - ordered=c("var1","var2") - from the above it works
 
Thanks in advance for all the help
 
Best,
John

messages.subject: Re: Error: semTools/runMI/imputed data... using ordered variables ...subscript out of bounds
parts: This turned out to be a bug in the runMI function in semTools when both ordered categorical indicators and exogenous variables were used. It has been corrected in the development version of semTools (thaks to Sunthud) at https://github.com/simsem/semTools/wiki

Dear Alex and Sunthud,
 
With this fix (when both ordered categorical indicators and exogenous variables were used), runMI doesn't calculate intercepts. This doesn't happen when I use the imputed data separately in lavaan. Could this is be a bug too? Below is the warning message I am getting. I appreciate all the help.
 
Warning message:
In lav_partable_check(lavpartable) :
  lavaan WARNING: parameter table does not contain intercepts for one or more variables:
 
Thanks,
John
